summary: One agent run on one screen: clock and cost, every step, who started whom, the tool calls, and Ask.
intent: Block: one agent run in detail. AgentMonitor as the header (live clock, cost, step strip, pending approval) and the selected step's ToolCallCard, beside AgentTree (who started whom), AgentTrail (the step log on the shared rail, status icon plus word) and an Ask panel (kit Chat) to ask or steer the agent. One selected step drives the monitor, tree, trail and tool call. Replaces LiveSession. With calls="all" the monitor is the one-row AgentMonitor bar (collapsed) and every started step's ToolCallCard stacks beside the trail, the failed one open. trace renders TraceWaterfall compact in place of the step strip.
useWhen: open one run from a list or an overview
see why a step failed and retry it
approve the run's next action with the full step history in view
ask or steer the agent while it runs
pause, resume or cancel a run
doNotUseWhen: many agents at a glance — AgentOverview

run.note: { name, meta?, status: AgentMonitor status, headline?, headlineNote?, elapsed?, cost?, axis?, pendingAction?, error?, tag? }. What AgentMonitor shows on top; tag goes on the trail title.

steps.note: AgentMonitor steps plus { agentId, label?, timer?, args?, result?, resultMeta?, error?, attempt? }; status adds "pending" (planned: in the trail, not in the strip). attempt { n, max } shows "Attempt 1 of 3" beside Retry on a failed step's ToolCallCard.

agents.note: AgentTree root: the orchestrator and its sub-agents. A step's agentId is a node id. Leave it out for one agent: no AgentTree renders.

calls.note: selected: the selected step's ToolCallCard (Empty when none). all: every started step's ToolCallCard in step order, the failed one open (all fold when the run is done); the monitor is the one-row bar, the trail and trace sit on the left, and Retry shows only on the ToolCallCard. Picking a trail step scrolls to its call. The trail uses AgentTrail variant="list" and the calls ToolCallCard variant="panel".

trace.note: TraceWaterfall spans { id, label, kind, startMs, endMs?, cost?, failed? }[]. Renders TraceWaterfall compact ("Run trace") in place of the monitor's step strip; hidden below 40rem of block width (time and cost stay in the monitor).

selectedStepId.note: Controlled selected step; null for none.

onSelectStep.note: (stepId | null) => void. From the strip, the trail or a tree node (that agent's open or latest step).

onApprove.note: () => void. The pending action: ApprovalCard or the waiting agent in the tree.

onStop.note: () => void. Running runs: Stop run (sm, outline, danger) beside Pause; a kit AlertDialog confirms it once.

onRetry.note: (stepId) => void. A failed step, from the run, the tree or the tool call.

messages.note: Chat messages { id?, role: "user" | "assistant", content, timestamp? }[] for the Ask panel. The panel shows when messages or onSend is set.

onSend.note: (text) => void. The one Ask or steer box.

thinking.note: The Ask panel shows the kit thinking state.

layout: calls="selected": left: AgentMonitor (or the compact trace in place of its strip) over the selected step's ToolCallCard (Empty when none); right: AgentTree (with agents) over AgentTrail over the Ask panel; in layout-split--primary

calls="all": the AgentMonitor bar across the top; then layout-split--secondary: AgentTree (with agents), the AgentTrail "Steps" and the compact trace on the left, every started step's ToolCallCard on the right. The block heading is screen-reader only (the page's PageHeader names the run)

the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem) of block width the columns stack (trail on top), so Ask ends the page; below --grid-breakpoint-sm (40rem) the trace hides

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
strip steps, trail steps and tree names are buttons with aria-pressed on the selected one; selecting it again clears
the tool call is a section labelled by its h3, which names the selected step
calls="all": the calls column is a section named "Tool calls"; each call is a kit ToolCallCard with its status as icon and word
the pending ApprovalCard, Pause, Resume, Cancel, Stop run and Retry are kit Buttons, keyboard reachable with the kit focus ring; Stop run opens a kit AlertDialog (focus trapped, Escape cancels)
the Ask panel is an aside (complementary) named "Ask <run>"; replies arrive in the Chat log
trail status words are visible text; the failed step has aria-current=step when nothing runs or waits
no motion of its own; the parts' motion is transform and opacity and off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not rebuild RunDetail from local cards; import the block
Do not keep a second selection in one of the parts; the block's one selected step drives them all
Do not add a LiveSession beside RunDetail; pass messages and onSend
Only one solid primary in the view: the ApprovalCard's approve while waiting, else Resume while paused, else the Ask send; a failed or running calls="all" run has none
snippet: <RunDetail run={run} steps={steps} calls="all" trace={spans} onRetry={retry} onPause={pause} onStop={stop} />
